evals.prompt: I just finished building a CLI tool in Go and the README is basically empty — just the project name. Can you review it and tell me what's missing? The file is at ./README.md
evals.expected_output: A structured review identifying missing README sections (description, installation, usage, examples, contributing, license) with specific recommendations following documentation standards
expectations: Review identifies missing standard README sections

evals.prompt: Our team docs are a mess — inconsistent headings, no code highlighting, broken links everywhere. Can you give me a checklist of what to fix across our docs/ folder?
evals.expected_output: A documentation quality checklist covering formatting, structure, links, and consistency issues with prioritized remediation steps
expectations: Provides a structured checklist or review framework

evals.prompt: I'm writing docs for a Python library that uses Sphinx. All my public functions need docstrings but I'm not sure what format to use — Google style vs NumPy style vs rST. What do you recommend and what should each docstring include?
evals.expected_output: Guidance on Python docstring formats with recommendation, required sections (Args, Returns, Raises), and examples showing the chosen format
expectations: Covers Google, NumPy, and rST docstring styles
Provides a clear recommendation with rationale
Shows example docstring with Args/Returns/Raises sections
